quote: The i-th output is the value of the i-th domain-slot corresponding to the description in the conversation status in the turn T.
outputs: slot values for dialogue state tracking

quote: Joint goal accuracy is used to evaluate the performance of the models. Predicted dialogue states are correct only when all of the predicted values exactly match the correct values.
We use Joint Goal Accuracy that is the average accuracy of predicting all slot assignments for a given service in a turn correctly to evaluate the main results of models.
